offers.t: Structural Engineer - Concrete and Steel Structures (Wind Industry)
offers.sn: YOUR TASKS: In this role, you will become a technical reference in assessing and solving structural challenges within our wind turbine fleet.
offers.rq: YOUR PROFILE: A Master’s degree in Civil Engineering or similar*. Fluency in English; German and/or Spanish are a plus. At least 5 years of experience in similar engineering roles. For foreign qualifications, recognition as the corresponding Spanish qualification is required . *For foreign qualifications, recognition as the corresponding Spanish degree equivalency is required when applying.
